PRODUCT OVERVIEW

Different tasks call for different vehicles.

This series covers aerial work, pumping unit maintenance, on-site support, waste collection and specialized transport. Applications, chassis and approved specifications vary by model; there is no single capacity or dimension for the entire series.

Tell us the task, operating environment and transport conditions. We will help confirm a suitable model, applicable approval and equipment requirements. Final equipment, dimensions and delivery configuration are subject to the confirmed order and actual vehicle.

APPLICATIONS

Explore by application

These groups organize the existing approved models by application. Capabilities depend on the specific model and equipment.

01 ACCESS & MAINTENANCE

Access & maintenance

Aerial work trucks and pumping unit service vehicles serve different tasks. Confirm equipment, dimensions and configuration for the selected model.

02 ON-SITE SUPPORT

On-site support

Select emergency support, command or communications vehicles according to the site requirements. Equipment and functions require further confirmation.

03 WASTE COLLECTION

Waste collection

Detachable-body garbage trucks address the relevant waste collection tasks. Confirm the body and equipment compatibility for the model and order.

04 SPECIALIZED TRANSPORT

Specialized transport

Timber semi-trailers and dangerous-goods tank-container skeletal trailers carry different cargo types. Confirm the cargo and applicable transport conditions first.
